business_summary: Elephant Holdings Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the development and provision of financial trading solutions. It operates through three segments: Financial trading solutions and other IT services, Bullion trading services, and AI-driven solutions. The company offers project-based, customised AI analytics and technology solutions to PRC-based customers. It also provides financial trading solutions that enable the trading of OTC-traded instruments, and exchange-traded instruments and fund management; trading systems, algo trading tools, and digital asset management platforms; other IT services; and trading platform equipped with advanced charting tools for trading gold and silver products. In addition, the company offers licensing and maintenance services; and initial set up and customization services, as well as sells computer software and hardware products. Further, it is involved in the development and supply of resource allocation, planning, scheduling, and management of software and services; provision of bullion trading services; properties investment; development of software and application; cryptocurrencies trading services; and development and implementation of artificial intelligence driven solutions. The company was formerly known as Novacon Technology Group Limited and changed its name to Elephant Holdings Group Limited in June 2025. Elephant Holdings Group Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
